text:
maya: heads up — onboarding magnet-30b-v2 (int4 build) on long-context stress. Repro: streaming prefill + stitched prefix. After ~18k tokens output drifts into repeating 'the' / anchor tokens. Anyone seen similar with kv stitching + per-layer qscale?

alon: what rotary/rope config did you use? default rotary_base? last time we hit drift when scale mismatch between prefill and in-flight.

seb: can you paste the minimal repro? try KVCACHE_DEBUG=1 and run with `./bin/serving --model magnet-30b-v2 --quant int4 --seq 20000 --prefill-mode=stream` — here is snippet I used earlier:
```
KVCACHE_DEBUG=1 ./bin/serve --model magnet-30b-v2 --quant=int4 
  --batch 1 --max-tokens 20000 --prefill_stride 1024
```

prateek: quick hypothesis: int4 per-layer clip/scale drift causes index aliasing when window > 16k and we do stitching. Try forcing `prefill_stride=512` and `kv_index_type=absolute` (not relative) to see if indices drift.

maya: attaching minimal prompt: "Summarize the following long document:" + 20k tokens of lorem. Int4 run: after ~18.2k tokens, decoder starts repeating 'the the the'. float16 baseline stays stable.

karen: can you upload the raw outputs + KVCACHE_DEBUG logs? Also compare with int8 baseline to see if it's quant-only.

ci-bot: nightly_pipeline/run/1777777001 — magnet-30b-v2 long-stress (int4) queued :eyes: 

alon: also check compiled rotary scaling — our compiler normalizes rotary by base=10000 vs model's saved base=65536; mismatch will show up as phase drift over long positions.

prateek: i'll run a controlled loop tonight with `rotary_scale_factor=0.5` anneal and a no-stitch variant to isolate. will post diffs.

maya: thanks — kicked off an overnight run with `prefill_stride=512`, kv_index_type=absolute, rot_scale_override=1.0. will share artifacts tomorrow AM.

seb: if you need a quick bisect, drop `layerwise_clip=off` to see if it's the scale quant per-layer.

maya: noted, will test. thanks all :pray:
